cases.messageText:
# Answer

Regulations 26 and 27 generally disallow input tax on specified expenses, subject to the scope limits and exceptions in the regulations and IRAS guidance, and business purpose alone does not make a blocked claim recoverable. [IRAS: GST (General) Regulations](https://www.iras.gov.sg/taxes/goods-services-tax-(gst)/claiming-gst-(input-tax)/conditions-for-claiming-input-tax)

The client is not currently established as eligible for GST recovery today because the nature, purpose, documentation, and potential input tax restrictions of the incurred expense remain unresolved. [IRAS: GST (General) Regulations](https://www.iras.gov.sg/taxes/goods-services-tax-(gst)/claiming-gst-(input-tax)/conditions-for-claiming-input-tax)

Applicability for the client expense remains unresolved under IRAS; the stated facts do not yet establish the outcome.
